A '''Podracing course''' existed within a large [[Unidentified Podracing city|city]] somewhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The track consisted of a long winding road that twisted through numerous tightly packed buildings. The course was a part of the [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]] [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] season. During one race on the course, the [[Devlikk/Legends|Devlikk]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Wan Sandage Jr.]] found himself about to be smashed in between the racers of the [[Ghishi (species)|Ghishi]] [[Kraid Nemmeso]] and the [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]]. As the two pilots made their move to crush Sandage, the crafty Devlikk abruptly slammed the brakes on his [[TurboDyne 99-U/Legends|''TurboDyne'' 99-U Podracer]], causing his attackers to careen into each other, and obliterate their pods. After the collision, Sandage continued the race unscathed from the explosive event.<ref name="RR" />

==Behind the scenes==
This course first appeared in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]''. The course and the event mentioned only appear in the game's opening cutscene, and does not appear anywhere else in the game. However, when looking through the game's files, information can be found indicating that the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="RR" /> a world covered in cities<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> like the one scene in the cutscene, was originally planned as a location but was cut.<ref name="RR" />
